write_up: Your resume tells a clear story from customer support to Customer Success Manager at Brightline Payroll Software. A recruiter can see the accounts you manage and the work you do across onboarding, reviews and renewals. The main question is what changed for those customers, especially when accounts were at risk or payroll runs failed.

Your account book is the best-written line: it names 48 mid-market accounts and the industries they’re in. That gives a recruiter a concrete picture of your remit. The onboarding checklist is another useful detail because you show that the whole CS team uses it.

Let’s start with the renewal strategy, then the payroll escalations. Add what you personally did and any results you can substantiate. You don’t need a number on every line, but those two moments deserve more of the story.

cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It puts the number of accounts, customer segment and industries together without making a recruiter hunt for them.
